steps.name: Probability Independence (Anti-Circularity)
steps.summary: Given the committed plinkoConfig.json multiplier table, independently-derived binomial probabilities P(slot)=C(rows,k)/2^rows produce 99.9% RTP (analytic identity over the full table) for all 27 configurations. All 351 per-slot probabilities exactly equal the independent binomial, and every board is confirmed a second time by walking all 2^rows paths through it and counting where they land — 9 boards, 130,816 paths, agreeing with an integer Pascal recurrence exactly and with the closed form and the operator's table inside 1e-12. The RTP proof is non-circular: probabilities come from stats.ts (binomProb) and from enumeration, not from plinkoConfig.json.

details.method: binomProb(rows, k) = C(rows,k) * 0.5^rows from stats.ts — not sourced from plinkoConfig.json; cross-checked by exhaustive 2^rows path enumeration and an integer Pascal recurrence
details.significance: Breaks circularity: theoretical RTP is computed from independently verified probabilities × observed multipliers.

testC.window: early = nonces 0–49 (the captured nonce range; in the 2 capture-retry epochs the missed nonce is the replayed one and captured nonce 50 falls in the reference window); reference = nonces 50–9999, the served sequence cycled by position (nonce n plays position n mod 50)

profileChecks.note: every revealed epoch (162, bound to the revealed-seed count) × 10,000 nonces is REPLAYED in verify on the boards of its own epoch (src/pass2-replay.ts; one HMAC scan per nonce gives the slot of every board), and the replay is bound to the capture: 8,100/8,100 captured bets re-read at their own nonce equal the served slot. TEST C is the profile's statistic: the payout sum of the 50 configurations the casino actually served at nonces 0–49 (the captured nonce range; nonce n ≥ 50 plays served position n mod 50) standardised by the EXACT per-board mean and variance (binomial slot law × the served bracket-0 multipliers); reference window = nonces 50–9,999. Duel's 8-dp multipliers are too fine a lattice for an exact convolution, so the null is Monte-Carlo calibration on 10,000 FRESH seeds derived by a fixed public rule (nullSeed) playing the same served sequence; p = (1 + #null ≤ z)/(R + 1). Pre-registered one-sided rule (the TEST_C_* constants in tests/steps/simulation.ts, WRITTEN 2026-09-24 BEFORE THE STATISTIC WAS FIRST COMPUTED, with the α values HouseBets and LIQD fixed for the same statistic; written after this capture's seeds were revealed, as for those packages): flag at p ≤ 0.01; flags aggregated by Poisson-binomial survival over the per-epoch null flag probability; survival < 0.001 → FAIL, < 0.01 → FLAG (marginal excess); BROAD (early AND reference window both p ≤ 0.001, reference null = bootstrap of 199 calibrated windows) → FAIL; pooled z < −3.090 → FAIL. Direction split and detection power are printed. Tests A and B of the committed artifact are now RE-DERIVED row by row from the replay (242 rows, 0 mismatches) instead of read. Measured: 1/162 epochs flagged (family survival 0.8037; the rule fails at 8), 0 broad, pooled z −0.554, early windows 98 below / 64 above expectation (the null expects 99.9 below); power at a 10% early-window shortfall 12.7% per epoch, 30.7% for the family if 25% of epochs were picked.
